cards.title: How to read it
items: Each node = one FULL block of 16 token ids + its physical block id
Root-to-node path = a token prefix; lookup walks block by block
rc = refcount = 1 (tree) + live requests whose table holds it
Request D matched only the system prompt; its own blocks are not full yet

cards.title: Eviction: evict(3)
items: Scan 1: leaves with rc exactly 1 are C·1 and B·1; free them in LRU order
C·0 has now become a leaf, so scan 2 finds it and frees it
A·2 and the system prompt are never touched while A or D runs
Never an inner node: its children would become unreachable

cards.title: Hit rate is not time saved
items: Prefill T(n) ≈ a + b·n + c·n²; at small n the fixed cost a dominates
